name: shadowpool
description: Root shim so a default-configured host (e.g. a plain Render Web Service, which ignores render.yaml and runs at the repo root) can build and run the ShadowPool node. Uses only npm — no pnpm, npx, or corepack — because hosts vary in what they provide and corepack cannot write to /usr/bin on Render. The real projects live in services/ and web/.
